dependency_semantics: Scoped prerequisite gates; assembly requires reviewed witnesses, not automatic inference from example outcomes.

conjectures.statement: Specify typed stagewise realization of mathematical objects, operations, identities, proofs and continuations.
conjectures.acceptance: Freeze validity, source rules, composition and dependent transport; distinguish supplied domain laws from laws generated by the process.
conjectures.falsifier: An endpoint-correct adapter fails an intermediate operation or licensed continuation.
conjectures.scope: Bounded interface definition and regression controls; example binding, universal realization and cross-metatheory translation are not discharged.

conjectures.statement: Audit the existing domain-WG pilot against that interface.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse actual supplied operations and histories; record which laws are imported and which constructed.
conjectures.falsifier: The wrapper merely assumes the law claimed to be generated.
conjectures.scope: Actual supplied Boolean/category operations and retained finite histories; category laws imported, Boolean proofs by cases, compiler bookkeeping constructed. No native category-law generation or multi-request native scheduling.

conjectures.statement: Use the existing RH arithmetic/analytic construction as a mathematical-realization example, preserving intermediate source types, domain/completion data and identity-continuation witnesses.
conjectures.acceptance: Map the actual RH net into the common interface without concealing rejected unchanged-Evans candidates or treating RH as a supplied true conclusion.
conjectures.falsifier: A proposed arithmetic-to-analytic identification loses an admissible continuation or requires fitting the residual away.
conjectures.scope: Bounded typed RH package binding with predictive continuation, declared normalization/completion and unchanged-Evans rejection retained; not RH truth or universal transport.

conjectures.statement: The bounded examples share the same realization semantics.
conjectures.acceptance: Reviewed compatible witnesses; successful examples remain scoped and do not prove universal coverage.
conjectures.falsifier: Each example uses incompatible meanings of identity, operation or validity.
conjectures.scope: Compatible typed-operation, retained-history and task-quotient semantics with distinct evidence policies; no source identification or cross-foundation translation.
